title: Mythic GME 2e Saved Formulas
description: Saved dice formulas. The app accepts two shapes: a bare list of formula objects, or an object with a required `formulas` list. The storage file `formulas/saved_formulas.json` is a bare list until the first label is saved on the Dice Studio Join tab; it is then the object form with `poolLabels`, plus `poolLabelColors` once a label has a chosen color, and it returns to a bare list when the last label is removed. Other object fields are kept on save. Export writes the object form with `formulas`, `version` ("1.0") and `schemaVersion` ("1") and no labels; Import ignores `poolLabels` and `poolLabelColors`. When loading the storage file `formulas/saved_formulas.json`, a row is rejected, and with it the whole file, when `formula` is missing or empty, when `name`, `description` or `id` is neither a string nor null, or when `dateAdded` is present but null or not a parseable date-time string. On Import, a missing, null or unreadable `dateAdded` is replaced with the import time, and `id` is ignored, while any row with a missing, empty, or unparseable `formula` fails validation and rejects the whole import. This schema follows the storage rule, so it rejects a null `dateAdded` that Import would accept.

oneOf.description: Bare list. The storage file uses this shape when it holds no labels.
Object form. Used by Export, and by the storage file once it holds labels.

poolLabels.description: Labels saved on the Dice Studio Join tab, in display order. Written by Mythic GME 1.7.0 and later. Storage file only; Export does not write it and Import ignores it.

poolLabelColors.description: The color chosen for a label, keyed by its name in `poolLabels`. A value is a quick color name or a custom `#RRGGBB` (the app writes it in uppercase). A label with no entry uses Automatic: it takes a quick color the other pools of the roll are not using. Entries for a name not in `poolLabels`, and values the app does not recognize, are ignored. Written by Mythic GME 1.7.0 and later, only when at least one label has a chosen color. Storage file only; Export does not write it and Import ignores it.

version.description: Written by Export as "1.0". Not read.

schemaVersion.description: Written by Export as "1". Not read.
